asked.item: LinkedIn comments and DMs in Inbox
TikTok comments and DMs in Inbox

verdict.reason: The Inbox page says it covers only Instagram and Facebook, that LinkedIn is unsupported, and that other connected platforms do not appear.

steps.text: Blotato's Inbox is one inbox for comments and direct messages from your Instagram accounts and Facebook Pages.
LinkedIn comments and direct messages are not supported in Inbox.
Other connected social platforms do not appear in Inbox, so use each platform's own inbox for those conversations.
